third_party_evaluations.summary: End-to-end pentest exam: external recon, AD pivoting, web, privesc, professional report.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded end-to-end assessment and professional reporting demonstrate delivery responsibility beyond the two-year profile; no recorded local framework recognition or senior leadership scope supports expert placement.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: An end-to-end practical covering reconnaissance, AD pivoting, web exploitation and a professional report supports professional pentest delivery. The two-year profile does not establish expert direction, and NICCS listing is context rather than baseline approval.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded end-to-end practical covers reconnaissance, AD pivoting, web testing, privilege escalation and a professional report. That directly demonstrates consulting delivery and warrants professional placement despite the two-year profile.
